name: kilo-code-kb-patch
description: Patches Kilo Code keyboard behavior: Enter for newline, Cmd+Enter to send, Cmd+Up/Down to recall earlier messages, smarter permission prompt key routing. Optional extras for chat math rendering and response typography.

commands.title: Kilo Code KB Patch: Apply Patches
Kilo Code KB Patch: Restore Originals
Kilo Code KB Patch: Show Status

kiloCodeKbPatch.addAttachFileButton.markdownDescription: Add a `+` button to the Kilo Code prompt toolbar that opens the file picker directly. Reload the window after changing.

kiloCodeKbPatch.renameOpenInTab.markdownDescription: Retitle Kilo Code's editor-title "Open in Tab" action to "Kilo Code: Open" so its icon groups next to other AI "Open" icons in the editor title bar. Reload the window after changing.

kiloCodeKbPatch.chatHistoryFontSizeEm.markdownDescription: Multiply the font size of the agent's rendered response in chat history, relative to Kilo Code's own **Display** font-size setting. `1` leaves it unchanged. Monospace content (code blocks, inline code, file paths) keeps its own size, as do reasoning blocks, tool output, and your own messages. Reload the window after changing.

kiloCodeKbPatch.chatHistoryFontFamily.markdownDescription: CSS `font-family` for the agent's rendered response in chat history, for example `Charter, Georgia, serif`. Empty keeps Kilo Code's font. Code, file paths, and math keep their own fonts. Reload the window after changing.

kiloCodeKbPatch.chatMathRendering.markdownDescription: Render `$...$` inline math and `\[...\]` display math in chat. Kilo Code already renders `$$...$$` and `\(...\)`. Reload the window after changing.

kiloCodeKbPatch.chatMathFontSizeEm.markdownDescription: Font size of rendered math in chat, in `em` relative to the text around it. `1.21` is KaTeX's own size. Applies only while `#kiloCodeKbPatch.chatMathRendering#` is on. Reload the window after changing.
